### Changed
- **Every OCIRepository this chart renders polls gsoci every minute: `gitops.sourceInterval`, default `1m`** (giantswarm/giantswarm-management-clusters#2589). The component OCIRepositories and the self-management one polled on `gitops.interval` and `gitops.self.interval` (`10m`), so a component or platform release pushed to gsoci was stored and installed up to ten minutes later. The sources now poll on `gitops.sourceInterval`; a poll is one tag list per chart. Every child HelmRelease keeps reconciling on `gitops.interval` and the self HelmRelease on `gitops.self.interval`, both `10m`, which now govern the HelmReleases only. `tests/verify-components.py` and `tests/verify-self.py` assert both cadences and both knobs.
